request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 and gcd(A,B,C)=1
request_state.title: RIBET LEVEL-LOWERING AND CUSP FORM VANISHING ON C623
request_state.claim: By pairwise disjointness of prime factors of ABC in primitive Beal triples, every odd prime p >= 5 dividing ABC has multiplicative reduction with valuation nu_p(Delta) = 2 * e_p * nu_p(base). Under Ribet level-lowering at exponent l | e_p, all prime-to-(2,3) factors divide out of the Serre conductor, reducing the target space to cusp forms S_2(N) with N dividing 144.
request_state.method: Frey curve y^2 = x(x - A^x)(x + B^y), Tate algorithm minimal conductor, Ribet level lowering, Modular form dimensional vanishing.

ribet_level_lowering_soundness.instructions: Is the application of Ribet level-lowering to eliminate prime-to-(2,3) factors from the Serre conductor unconditionally sound when the discriminant valuation nu_p(Delta) is a multiple of exponent l >= 3?

criteria.true: Unconditionally sound; standard Serre-Ribet level lowering theorem removes primes with l | nu_p(Delta).
criteria.false: Flawed or requires unverified local hypotheses.

minimal_conductor_support.instructions: What is the prime support of the minimal Serre level N_l after Ribet level-lowering on Frey curves for Beal triples?

criteria.purely_primes_2_and_3: Prime support is strictly contained in {2, 3}, so N_l in {2, 6, 18, 32, 64, 72, 144}.
criteria.unbounded_bad_primes: Support depends on unbounded prime set primes(ABC).
criteria.wild_ramification_at_all_p: Wild ramification introduces additional prime factors.

cusp_form_vanishing.instructions: Which modular form spaces have dimension zero (dim S_2(N) = 0), immediately precluding non-trivial representations?

criteria.levels_2_6_18_zero: Levels 2, 6, and 18 all have dim S_2(N) = 0 (completely empty newform spaces).

target_signature_elimination.instructions: Which signature classes are completely eliminated by dimensional vanishing when N_l divides 18?

criteria.signature_nn2_and_nn3: Signatures (n, n, 2) and (n, n, 3) (and subcases of (3, 3, p)) are completely eliminated.
criteria.no_signatures_eliminated: No signatures are eliminated; all require Kraus sieve.
criteria.all_signatures_eliminated: All Beal signatures are eliminated simultaneously.
